game_title: Divide Or Floor – Pyre Summit Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit, the roaring summit: the volcanologist must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split ember crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit: the roaring summit
core_gameplay_loop: In Pyre Summit, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split ember crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the share value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the obsidian gate using at most 23 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The obsidian gate reached with actions_used <= 23.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the obsidian gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 10 (extended tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Pyre Summit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Pyre Summit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The obsidian gate reached with actions_used <= 23.
